lines: A J Suriyanarayana, Promoter, is receiving proceeds from selling 25,000 shares in the open market.
They sold on 19 Oct 2026 and the money settled on 20 Oct 2026, 27 days ago.
Ask how they plan to deploy the proceeds, since the sale was recent and cash is now available.
